irreducible_incompleteness.description: Registry of incompleteness types that are intrinsic to the mathematical structure and cannot be removed by additional definitions.

entries.reason: Non-local sum over CSI domains is a many-to-one mapping; unique preimage recovery is mathematically impossible without path history.
Degenerate minima result in multi-branch retention; forcing uniqueness would violate process symmetry requirements.
States outside the admissibility window map to null; original deviation values are non-recoverable from the projected state.

irreducible_incompleteness.governance_note: Irreducible incompleteness must be preserved as a formal boundary; any claim of resolution is a governance violation.
